parole.testo: Uncertain. Possibly from a Berber form abaʕbuʕ, which Lameen Souag links to babbūš as a local expressive adaptation of it. If so, then doublet of bebbux.
Probably of Berber origin. Compare Kabyle agenduz (“calf”).

parole.significato: sty, pigsty (an enclosure where pigs are kept)
parole.testo: Probably from Berber, Compare Mozabite Berber takerbušt and Wargli Berber tikerbas(t)("doomed room").
